## Walkthrough The operator now uses an OpenShift API server encryption status provider for KMS health commands. The project also updates its Go toolchain, dependencies, CI build image, and Docker builder and runtime images. ### Changes **KMS encryption status integration** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Provider implementation and command wiring**
`pkg/operator/encryptionstatusprovider/provider.go`, `cmd/cluster-openshift-apiserver-operator/main.go`|Reads and applies encryption status on the `cluster` OpenShiftAPIServer resource and registers the provider with the KMS health command.| **Platform and dependency refresh** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Toolchain and dependency updates**
`go.mod`|Updates Go to 1.26 and refreshes OpenShift, Kubernetes, gRPC, telemetry, and related modules.| |**Build and runtime image updates**
`.ci-operator.yaml`, `Dockerfile`|Updates CI, builder, and runtime images to the Go 1.26 and OpenShift 5.0 release versions while retaining artifact wiring and labels.| **Estimated code review effort:** 2 (Simple) | ~10 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant NewSSCSCommand participant kmshealth participant encryptionstatusprovider participant OpenShiftAPIServer NewSSCSCommand->>encryptionstatusprovider: Create provider from rest.Config NewSSCSCommand->>kmshealth: Register command with provider kmshealth->>encryptionstatusprovider: Get or apply encryption status encryptionstatusprovider->>OpenShiftAPIServer: Read or apply cluster status ``` **Suggested reviewers:** `ingvagabund` --- > [!IMPORTANT] > ## Pre-merge checks failed > > Please resolve all errors before merging. Skipping docstring coverage check. | | Linked Issues check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Out of Scope Changes check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | No `_test.go` files changed, and the touched source files add no Ginkgo titles; the PR only alters wiring/provider/build config. | | Test Structure And Quality | ✅ Passed | PASS: The PR delta adds no Ginkgo test files or test code changes, so the test-structure checklist is not applicable. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | No new Ginkgo e2e tests were added; the PR only changes command wiring, provider code, and build config. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PASS: No new Ginkgo/e2e test files or spec declarations were added; only command wiring, provider code, and build/dependency config changed. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | The only code change is a KMS encryption-status provider and CLI wiring; no node selectors, anti-affinity, spread constraints, replica logic, or topology checks were added. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | No new process-level stdout writes were added; the new provider is stdout-free and main.go only registers a command. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | No new or modified Ginkgo e2e tests were added; the PR only changes command wiring and build images, so the IPv6/network check is not applicable. | | No-Weak-Crypto | ✅ Passed | Changed files only add OpenShift KMS status wiring/provider logic; no MD5/SHA1/DES/RC4/3DES, custom crypto, or secret-comparison code found. | | No-Sensitive-Data-In-Logs | ✅ Passed | The PR adds no sensitive-data logging; the new provider and command wiring contain no log calls, only generic errors and status fetch/apply logic. |
